user.title: Add WristWand
user.description: WristWand lets an Amazfit / Zepp OS watch control things you point at. After adding it, open WristWand on the watch and choose Pair: Home Assistant will show a pairing code to enter on the watch. Each paired watch appears as a device; delete the device to unpair it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: WristWand is already set up. Pair more watches from the watch itself.
